integrity: Proof and code describe the same precise configuration-level theorem; prior authors are credited. No independent external audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the ordinary undirected friendship graph F_k=K_1 join kK_2, integer k>=2, with nonnegative integer configurations and the ordinary 2-for-1 pebbling move. No claim for clearing numbers or arbitrary cactus/block graphs. Exhaustive tests are finite and are not an infinite proof; the all-parameter proof is self-contained. Bibliographic uncertainty includes unindexed equivalent work.
title: Exact hub consolidation and stacking on friendship graphs
